description.p: A cross-platform authenticator that generates TOTP (RFC 6238) and HOTP (RFC 4226) codes entirely on the device. There is no backend, no account and no telemetry: it makes no outbound network connection of any kind, which makes it usable on air-gapped and restricted networks.

Secrets are sealed with AES-256-GCM under an Argon2id-derived key and stored in the operating system's own credential store. On Linux that is the Secret Service, so a keyring daemon must be installed and unlocked.

ul.li: TOTP, HOTP and Steam Guard codes
Unlock with a PIN or a passphrase, with optional biometrics
Add accounts by pasting a QR image, dragging one in, or typing the key
Import from Google Authenticator, Aegis and 2FAS
Encrypted local backup, protected by its own passphrase
